report.value: C 3.3 uF, R = 170 ms / (0.7 x 3.3 uF) = 73.6 kOhm. Terms: setting 1.5 %, R 0.25 %, C 0.5 %, K supply 0.10 %, leakage 0.63 % (0.283 uA x 73.6 kOhm / 3.3 V). Sum 2.98 %: 164.9 ms to 175.1 ms. With the typical temperature term of Fig. 17 at 4.5 V (0.39 %) the sum is 3.37 %: 164.3 ms to 175.7 ms, 9.3 ms inside each bound. Timing current 44.8 uA. The 74HC423's stated terms give 161.6 ms to 178.4 ms, with its temperature term not stated

report.value: Fig. 15 (CEXT 100 nF, 25 degC), 600 dpi, 1 pixel = 0.001 normalized. At 3.201 / 3.3 / 3.399 V: 1 MOhm curve 0.9925 / 0.9935 / 0.9945; 5.6 kOhm curve 1.035 / 1.034 / 1.034. Fig. 17 (4.5 V, CEXT 1 uF). At 0 / 25 / 50 degC: 1 MOhm curve 1.006 / 1.008 / 1.011; 5.6 kOhm curve 1.022 / 1.026 / 1.029. Section 1: typical pulse width variation over temperature +/-0.2 %. TI gives limits at VCC 3 V (RX 10 kOhm, CX 0.1 uF): 0.64 ms to 0.78 ms at 25 degC and 0.612 ms to 0.812 ms at -40 to 85 degC. Those limits include unit spread, so a temperature drift cannot be separated from them

report.value: The enabling levels are the opposite of the '423's. nB (rising edge, pin 4) triggers while nA is HIGH, and nA (falling edge, pin 5) triggers while nB is LOW. So the half fed on nB parks nA HIGH, and the half fed on nA parks nB LOW. The pin functions match TI's CD74HC4538 pin for pin: TI names pin 4 A and pin 5 B. The reset input has no Schmitt action: 625 ns/V at 2.0 V, 139 ns/V at 4.5 V (Nexperia); 1000 ns at 2 V, 500 ns at 4.5 V (TI). Section 11.1 calls for a damping diode across a large CEXT, and TI's Power-Down Mode section does so from 0.5 uF
report.source: Nexperia 74HC4538 Rev. 7 Tables 2, 3 and 5, section 11.1; TI SCHS123E pinout, truth table, page 4 and Power-Down Mode
